external_entities.name: Customers
external_entities.description: People who browse and place sock orders through the mobile app.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

external_entities.name: Marketing
external_entities.description: The marketing staff who maintain the catalogue spreadsheet.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Marketing keep the catalogue in a spreadsheet.

processes.name: Mobile app
processes.description: The mobile application customers use to browse and order socks.
processes.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

processes.name: Web API
processes.description: The API used by the mobile app, which stores customer data and hands orders to SIMS.
processes.source_excerpt: The web API keeps customers in the user database
processes.notes: Authentication behavior is unknown: "Nobody here can tell me what the API does about authentication".

processes.name: SIMS
processes.description: The stock and inventory system that receives orders, writes delivery addresses, and sends dispatch notes.
processes.source_excerpt: SIMS does two things with an order.

processes.name: Macros
processes.description: Spreadsheet macros that send SQL statements to the Web API to change prices and product copy.
processes.source_excerpt: The macros in it send SQL statements straight to the web API to change prices and product copy

processes.name: Fax gateway
processes.description: The gateway that receives dispatch notes and faxes customer confirmations.
processes.source_excerpt: it sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway, which faxes the customer a confirmation
processes.notes: The text says the gateway dials the number stored against the order and nobody checks that the fax arrived at the right place.

data_stores.name: User database
data_stores.description: The database holding customer names, addresses, and the card they paid with.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The web API keeps customers in the user database: name, address, and the card they paid with.
data_stores.notes: Encryption at rest is unknown: "Nobody here can tell me ... whether the user database ... [is] encrypted."

data_stores.name: Flat file
data_stores.description: A flat file kept alongside SIMS containing delivery addresses only.
data_stores.source_excerpt: It writes the delivery address into a flat file kept alongside it — only addresses go in that file, nothing else
data_stores.notes: Encryption at rest is unknown: "Nobody here can tell me ... whether ... the flat file [is] encrypted."

data_stores.name: Spreadsheet
data_stores.description: The marketing catalogue containing product prices and product copy.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Marketing keep the catalogue in a spreadsheet.
data_stores.notes: The spreadsheet lives on a marketing laptop in the office.

data_flows.name: browse and order
data_flows.description: Customers browse and place sock orders through the mobile app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

data_flows.name: API requests
data_flows.description: The mobile app communicates with the Web API over HTTP.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app talks to the web API over HTTP — not HTTPS

data_flows.name: store customer data
data_flows.description: The Web API keeps customer names, addresses, and payment card information in the user database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The web API keeps customers in the user database: name, address, and the card they paid with.
data_flows.data_description: customer name, address, and payment card

data_flows.name: hand over order
data_flows.description: The Web API hands an order over to SIMS.
data_flows.source_excerpt: When an order is placed the API hands the order over to SIMS

data_flows.name: write delivery address
data_flows.description: SIMS writes the delivery address into the flat file.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It writes the delivery address into a flat file kept alongside it

data_flows.name: send dispatch note
data_flows.description: SIMS sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway.
data_flows.source_excerpt: it sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway

data_flows.name: fax confirmation
data_flows.description: The fax gateway faxes customers a confirmation containing their name and address.
data_flows.source_excerpt: which faxes the customer a confirmation with their name and address on it
data_flows.notes: The gateway dials the number stored against the order and nobody checks it arrived at the right place.

data_flows.name: change catalogue
data_flows.description: Spreadsheet macros send SQL statements to the Web API to change prices and product copy.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The macros in it send SQL statements straight to the web API to change prices and product copy

data_flows.name: maintain catalogue
data_flows.description: Marketing keeps the catalogue in the spreadsheet.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Marketing keep the catalogue in a spreadsheet.

trust_boundaries.name: Office
trust_boundaries.description: The office network location where the marketing laptop hosting the spreadsheet is located.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The spreadsheet lives on a marketing laptop in the office.

assumptions.assumption: The mobile app presents a non-web interface.
assumptions.basis: The source identifies it as a mobile app rather than a website or web interface.

assumptions.assumption: The Web API presents a web interface.
assumptions.basis: The source explicitly calls it the Web API.
It contains customer names and addresses plus payment card information.
It is described as a stock and inventory system, not a web application.

assumptions.assumption: The spreadsheet macros present a non-web interface.
assumptions.basis: They are spreadsheet macros that issue SQL statements rather than a web application interface.

assumptions.assumption: The fax gateway presents a non-web interface.
assumptions.basis: It is described as a fax gateway rather than a web application.
